content: Refund requests must be made within 7 days of receiving the product. The item must be intact and in its original packaging. For electronic items, refunds are not applicable if the seal is broken.
Inside City delivery charge is $2 and takes 1-2 days. Outside City charge is $5 and takes 3-5 days. Free shipping is available for orders over $500.
We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), Credit/Debit Cards, and Digital Wallets. Pre-paid orders via card receive an additional 5% discount.
Orders can be canceled only before the shipment process begins. Once shipped, a cancellation fee may apply.
Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery for non-perishable items. Perishable goods cannot be returned.
Electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Accessories have a 6-month warranty. Warranty does not cover physical damage.
Exchanges are allowed within 7 days for size or color issues. The item must be unworn with tags attached.
If you receive a damaged item, contact support within 48 hours. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund.
If your package is marked delivered but not received, wait 24 hours. Then file a claim. We will investigate and reship or refund within 5 business days.
Backordered items ship within 2-3 weeks. You will not be charged until the item ships.
We do not offer price matching with competitors. However, we run weekly flash sales with up to 40% off.
Gift cards are non-refundable and expire 12 months from purchase. They cannot be used to purchase other gift cards.
Local taxes are included in the price. International orders may incur customs duties payable by the customer.
Only one promo code per order. Codes cannot be combined with other offers unless explicitly stated.
Orders of 10+ identical items qualify for a 15% bulk discount. Contact sales@example.com for bulk quotes.
Subscriptions auto-renew monthly. Cancel anytime before the next billing cycle. No refunds for partial months.
Pre-orders charge your card immediately. Estimated shipping dates are provided. You may cancel pre-orders within 72 hours with no penalty.
International shipping costs $20 flat rate. Delivery takes 7-14 business days. Tracking is provided.
Store credit never expires. It can be used for any product on the website including sale items.
Live chat: Mon-Fri 9 AM-6 PM. Email support responds within 24 hours. Phone support is available Mon-Sat 10 AM-4 PM.
To delete your account, contact support. All data is removed within 30 days. Outstanding orders must be completed first.
We do not sell your personal data. Payment details are encrypted. You can opt out of marketing emails at any time.
You must be 18+ to purchase certain items including electronics and accessories. ID may be requested.
Reselling our products requires a wholesale agreement. Contact wholesale@example.com for terms.
All products are 100% authentic. Counterfeit items are not tolerated and will result in a full refund plus store credit.
Size exchanges are free for Apparel items. We cover return shipping once per order.
Items marked 'Final Sale' cannot be returned or exchanged unless defective. Clearance items are final sale.
Partial refunds may be issued for missing items or delayed shipping. The refund amount is at our discretion.
Order modifications (size, color, address) are allowed within 1 hour of placing the order. After that, cancel and reorder.
If the price drops within 7 days of your purchase, we refund the difference up to $50.
Students get 10% off with valid .edu email verification. Excludes electronics and gift cards.
Active military and veterans receive 15% off. ID verification required via ID.me.
Sign up for our loyalty program to receive a 20% off birthday coupon valid for 30 days.
Earn 1 point per $1 spent. 100 points = $5 off. Points expire after 6 months of inactivity.
Refer a friend — they get $10 off first order, you get $10 store credit after their first purchase.
Items purchased between Nov 1 and Dec 25 can be returned until Jan 31.
You can leave special delivery instructions like 'leave at back door'. We are not liable for theft after delivery photos are taken.
Orders over $300 require a signature upon delivery. You can waive this at your own risk.
If a package is returned as undeliverable, we will refund the order minus a $10 restocking fee.
If you accidentally place a duplicate order, contact us immediately. Both orders will be canceled without penalty if within 1 hour.
Sign up for 'back in stock' alerts on a product page. We will email you when stock is replenished.
You can submit reviews after purchase. Verified buyer reviews are marked. We do not remove negative reviews unless they violate guidelines.
Affiliates earn 8% commission on sales. Payouts are monthly via PayPal. Minimum payout $50.
COD orders have a $3 service fee. You must have exact change. Drivers cannot make change.
We accept Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal. Digital wallet payments are processed immediately and subject to the same refund policies.
Pay in 4 installments via Klarna or Afterpay. No interest. Late fees may apply for missed payments.
We accept Bitcoin and Ethereum. Crypto payments are non-refundable due to volatility, but store credit is issued.
Tracking numbers are provided via email within 24 hours of shipment. Use our website or carrier's portal.
We are not responsible for delays caused by weather, strikes, or carrier issues. We will notify you of known delays.
Order data is retained for 7 years for tax purposes. Chat logs are kept for 90 days.
